app.name: Holy Auramaxing
app.description: Daily check-ins, small groups and encouragement, grounded in grace.

sos.title: Take a breath
sos.description: You reached out. That took courage. Stay here for a minute.
sos.breathe: Breathe in slowly for four counts, hold for four, and breathe out for six.
sos.verseText: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
sos.prayer: Lord, this moment is hard. Give me strength for the next minute, and show me the way out you promised. Amen.
sos.openOffline: Open breathing, Scripture and the timer
sos.afterSlip: Already slipped? There’s grace for that too.
sos.afterSlipText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
sos.afterSlipNext: When you’re ready, check in honestly. A slip resets a streak, never you.

breathing.heading: Breathe for a minute
breathing.body: Follow the circle: in for four, hold for four, out for six. Four slow breaths take about a minute.
breathing.done: Well done. Notice how your body feels now.

cor10.text: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

jas4.text: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

php4.text: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

psa119.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word. With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments. I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

gal5.text: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

wave.heading: Ride the wave
wave.body: A strong feeling rises, peaks and fades, usually within minutes. Stay with it for ten minutes. You don’t have to do anything else.
wave.fiveLeft: Five minutes left. You’re doing well.
wave.done: You rode the wave. Well done.
wave.paused: Paused. Carry on whenever you’re ready.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lede: How we collect, use and protect your information.

whoWeAre.heading: Who we are
whoWeAre.body: Holy Auramaxing (“we”) is a small, grace-centred app run for friends walking together toward freedom. For anything about your data, contact our grievance officer at the address below.

whatWeCollectAndWhy.heading: What we collect, and why
whatWeCollectAndWhy.body:
Account details: your email address, the display name and handle you choose, your time zone and your theme. We use these to run your account. If you sign in with Google, we keep only your email address from Google, not your name or photo.

Your profile: the photo, bio, testimony and favourite verse you add, shown only to the people you choose.

Your answers at sign-up: that you confirmed you are 18 or older, which policy version you agreed to, and when.

Check-ins, mood, urges, triggers and notes, once you start using them. These reveal private parts of your life, so we treat them as sensitive personal data and only process them with your explicit consent.

Group membership and what you post in a group, shown only to that group's members.

Your progress: your level, XP and badges, worked out from your check-ins. A group sees your level and badges only if you share at least your streak with it, and your check-in details only at the level you choose for that group.

Encouragement: the nudges you send and receive (kept for 90 days), and accountability partners you choose together. A partner sees your full check-ins in that group, and, only if you allow it, is told when you miss two days or ask for prayer.

Recovery tools, only if you use them: your journal, encrypted so only you can read it; how many times you rode out a hard moment with the SOS button (just the number); and a phone number you choose to share with your accountability partners, encrypted and shown only to them. Words you type are checked for signs of crisis on your device only, and never sent anywhere for it.

Notifications: what we have to tell you, kept for 90 days, and your choices about them. If you turn on push, your browser's push service (Google, Mozilla, Apple or Microsoft, depending on your browser) receives an encrypted message it can't read and the address of your device for it.

Security records: sign-ins, password changes, exports and deletions, with a rough device name such as “Chrome on Android”, kept for one year to protect your account. We do not keep your IP address: our sign-in provider sees it while you sign in, and we clear it within the hour.

whatWeNeverDo.heading: What we never do
whatWeNeverDo.body: We never sell or share your information, never show ads, never use trackers or fingerprinting, and never use what you write to train AI. We only set cookies that the app needs to work.

whoProcessesDataForUs.heading: Who processes data for us
whoProcessesDataForUs.body: Supabase (database and sign-in, hosted in Mumbai, India), Cloudflare (bot protection), Google Cloud Vision (checks uploaded profile and group pictures for explicit images; it receives only the picture), Google (only if you choose to sign in with Google), the browser push services named above (only if you turn on push), our email provider (for now Google's Gmail), and our web host. Each processes data only on our instructions under a data processing agreement.

howLongWeKeepIt.heading: How long we keep it
howLongWeKeepIt.body: While your account is open, except notifications and nudges, which we keep for 90 days, and security records, kept for one year. If you delete your account, we wait 14 days in case you change your mind, then permanently delete your personal data. Anything you posted in a group is anonymised. Backups roll over within 30 days.

yourRights.heading: Your rights
yourRights.body: You can see, correct, download and delete your data, withdraw consent, and nominate someone to act for you, from Settings or by writing to us. We reply within 30 days. You can also complain to your data protection authority, such as the Data Protection Board of India.

children.heading: Children
children.body: The app is only for adults. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18, and the sign-up does not create an account for anyone who says they are under 18.

grievanceOfficer.heading: Grievance officer
grievanceOfficer.body:
For any question or complaint about your data, contact our grievance officer: Paulz, paulangelogamer@gmail.com. We acknowledge every message within 7 days and aim to resolve it within 30 days.

If you're not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India or your local data protection authority.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.lede: The simple rules for using the app together.

whoCanUseTheApp.heading: Who can use the app
whoCanUseTheApp.body: You must be 18 or older and give honest answers when you sign up.

notAMedicalService.heading: Not a medical service
notAMedicalService.body: The app supports your journey with check-ins, encouragement and Scripture. It does not diagnose or treat any condition and is not a substitute for a counsellor, doctor or pastor. If you are in crisis, contact a local helpline or emergency services.

lookingAfterEachOther.heading: Looking after each other
lookingAfterEachOther.body: Be kind, keep what others share in confidence, and never post sexual content. We remove content and accounts that break these rules, and we report child sexual abuse material to the authorities.

yourAccount.heading: Your account
yourAccount.body: Keep your password safe and tell us if you think someone else has used your account. You can delete your account at any time.

changes.heading: Changes
changes.body: If these terms change in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app before the change takes effect.

yourData.title: Your data, in plain words
yourData.lede: A short, honest summary of what happens to what you share.

privateByDefault.heading: Private by default
privateByDefault.body: Nothing you do is public. Your profile is only visible to people in your groups, field by field as you choose. Check-in details are shared only at the level you pick for each group.

discreetEverywhere.heading: Discreet everywhere
discreetEverywhere.body: Browser tabs, the addresses in your browser history, emails, their links and notifications use the name “Holy Auramaxing” and never mention what the app is about, or how a day went.

yoursToTakeOrDelete.heading: Yours to take or delete
yoursToTakeOrDelete.body: You can download everything as a file, or delete your account. Deletion is final after 14 days.

protected.heading: Protected
protected.body: Your sign-in uses secure, encrypted cookies. Passwords are checked against known data breaches without ever sending your password anywhere. The most sensitive notes are encrypted before they are stored.

accountData.title: Your data
accountData.lede: It’s yours. Take a copy whenever you like, or delete your account.

export.title: Download my data
export.body: One file with everything we hold about you: your profile and photo, your settings, your private “my why”, your check-ins with their private notes, your groups and what you share in them, what you agreed to at sign-up, and your security records. It opens on any phone or computer, and includes a copy for spreadsheets.
export.warning: The file includes private things. Keep it somewhere safe, and delete it when you no longer need it.
export.readme:
This is a copy of everything Holy Auramaxing holds about you.

data.json has everything in one file. The csv folder has the same information as one spreadsheet per topic. Times are in UTC.

This file includes private things. Keep it somewhere safe, and delete it when you no longer need it.

What's inside:

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.body: You can delete your account at any time. You’ll have 14 days to change your mind.

deletePage.title: Delete your account
deletePage.lede: Thank you for being here. Whatever comes next, you’re always welcome back.
deletePage.hardStretch: If you’re leaving because things feel heavy right now, nothing you’ve done closes this door. You can come back any time.
deletePage.step1: Your profile disappears from everyone else straight away, and your other devices are signed out.
deletePage.step2: For 14 days you can sign in and choose Keep my account. Everything will be as you left it.
deletePage.step3: After 14 days, your account and your personal data are deleted for good. Anything you shared in a group stays there, shown as “A former member”.
deletePage.step4: Deleted data leaves our backups within 30 days. We keep a record that an account was deleted, with nothing that says whose.
deletePage.copyFirstBody: Download your data before you go. You can also do this during the 14 days.
deletePage.confirm: I understand that after 14 days my account is deleted for good.
deletePage.goBack: Keep my account and go back

closing.verseText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

resources.title: Resources
resources.lede: Help for the hard days, and for building a life you don’t want to escape from.
resources.notMedical: Holy Auramaxing is not a medical service and can’t replace a counsellor, doctor or pastor.
resources.crisisHeading: If you need someone to talk to now
resources.crisisBody: These lines are free and confidential. Your own country is first, if we could tell from your time zone.
resources.crisisOther: Somewhere else? Find a line near you at findahelpline.com.
resources.crisisEmergency: If you are in danger right now, call your local emergency number (112 in India, 911 in the US).
resources.filtersBody: Filters don’t change a heart, but they buy you time in a weak moment. Set them up on a good day, and let someone you trust hold the password if you can.

dns.title: Family-safe DNS for your whole home
dns.body: On your Wi-Fi router, set the DNS servers to a family filter such as CleanBrowsing Family (185.228.168.168 and 185.228.169.168) or OpenDNS FamilyShield (208.67.222.123 and 208.67.220.123). Every device on that Wi-Fi is then filtered.

android.title: Android
android.body: Settings → Network & internet → Private DNS → “Private DNS provider hostname”, then enter family-filter-dns.cleanbrowsing.org. In Google Family Link or Digital Wellbeing you can also set app limits.

iphone.title: iPhone and iPad
iphone.body: Settings → Screen Time → Content & Privacy Restrictions → App Store, Media, Web & Games → Web Content → Limit Adult Websites. Ask someone you trust to set the Screen Time passcode.

windows.title: Windows and Mac
windows.body: Use your router’s family DNS (above), or set the computer’s DNS to the same family servers in its network settings. Microsoft Family Safety (Windows) and Screen Time (Mac) can also limit websites.

resources.counsellorBody: There is no shame in getting help. A counsellor who understands compulsive behaviour, ideally one who shares your faith, can help with what lies underneath.

counsellor.c1: Ask your pastor or church leaders who they would recommend.
counsellor.c2: In India, Tele-MANAS (14416) can also connect you with a counsellor near you.
counsellor.c3: Look for a licensed counsellor or psychologist, and ask whether they have worked with people facing compulsive sexual behaviour.

resources.booksBody: A few books many people have found helpful. We’re still asking pastors to review this list.

books.b1: Surfing for God, Michael John Cusick
books.b3: Every Man’s Battle, Stephen Arterburn and Fred Stoeker

resources.sosBody: The SOS button is on every screen: breathing, Scripture, a ten-minute timer and your people, one tap away.

contact.title: A number your partners can call
